		set_temp_variable = { fo_left = { value = fo_free subtract = fo_used max = 0 } }

		# stranded while another needed line has room. Passes = line count.

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0.5 } check_variable = { fo_def_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 0.5 } }
			set_variable = { fo_plan_amphibious_mechanized_equipment = fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment }
			set_variable = { fo_amount_amphibious_mechanized_equipment = fo_def_amphibious_mechanized_equipment }
			if = { limit = { has_tech = amphibious_mechanized_infantry_2 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 14.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = amphibious_mechanized_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 15 amount = fo_amount_amphibious_mechanized_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 13.5 } }

				}

					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = amphibious_mechanized_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 12 amount = fo_amount_amphibious_mechanized_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 10.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = amphibious_mechanized_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 11 amount = fo_amount_amphibious_mechanized_equipment }

				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_amphibious_mechanized_equipment > 8.5 } }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 14.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 15 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 13.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 14 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 12.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 13 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 11.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 12 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 10.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 11 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 9.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 10 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 8.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 9 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 7.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 8 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 6.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 7 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 5.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 6 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 4.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 5 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 3.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 4 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 2.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 3 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 1.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 2 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_train_equipment > 0.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = train_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 1 amount = fo_amount_train_equipment }
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 0.5 } check_variable = { fo_def_transport_plane_equipment > 0.5 } }
			set_variable = { fo_plan_transport_plane_equipment = fo_share_transport_plane_equipment }
			set_variable = { fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment = fo_def_transport_plane_equipment }
			if = { limit = { OR = { has_tech = strategic_airlifter has_tech = bba_strategic_airlifter } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 14.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 15 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 13.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 14 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 12.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 13 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 11.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 12 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 10.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 11 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 9.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 10 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 8.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 9 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 7.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 8 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 6.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 7 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 5.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 6 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 4.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 5 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 3.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 4 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 2.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 3 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 1.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 2 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 0.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_3 } requested_factories = 1 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_tech = improved_transport_plane has_tech = bba_improved_transport_plane } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 14.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 15 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 13.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 14 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 12.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 13 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 11.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 12 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 10.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 11 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 9.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 10 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 8.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 9 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 7.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 8 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 6.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 7 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 5.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 6 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 4.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 5 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 3.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 4 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 2.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 3 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 1.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 2 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 0.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_2 } requested_factories = 1 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_tech = early_transport_plane has_tech = bba_early_transport_plane } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 14.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 15 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 13.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 14 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 12.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 13 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 11.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 12 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 10.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 11 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 9.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 10 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 8.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 9 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 7.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 8 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 6.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 7 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 5.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 6 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 4.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 5 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 3.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 4 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 2.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 3 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 1.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 2 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fo_share_transport_plane_equipment > 0.5 } }
					add_equipment_production = { equipment = { type = transport_plane_equipment_1 } requested_factories = 1 amount = fo_amount_transport_plane_equipment }
				}
			}
		}

		set_country_flag = { flag = fo_cooldown days = 7 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { fo_has_plan = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { fo_has_plan = 0 }
	}
}
